home.title: {siteName} — 为盲人和低视力人士打造的感官步道,印加圣谷
home.description: 位于 Peru Cusco 印加圣谷的一条教育性感官步道,正在为盲人和低视力人士及其家人、朋友和陪伴者开发中。
home.heroAlt: 项目海报。一位戴毛线帽、穿橙色斗篷的人手持白手杖，沿着木栅栏旁的石板路行走，经过一栋有一位妇女和一个孩子的两层石屋。两个人在鸡群中的绿田里栽种，两只美洲鸵站在石墙边，后面是白雪覆盖的群山。海报上的文字：INCA BRAILLE TRAIL — GUIDING YOUR STEPS THROUGH THE CYCLE OF LIFE。一块牌子写着项目正在建设中，急需志愿者。
home.tagline:
First of its kind educational and sensory journey through the cycle of life and Andean agriculture

Designed for blind and visually impaired people.

Sighted visitors can choose to wear a blindfold for the trail. By briefly setting sight aside, they can tune in to the sounds, textures, and scents of the farm, discovering details they might usually miss and feeling more connected to the natural world.
home.banner: 本网站是一个建设中的项目。

boxes.title: 什么是 Inca Braille Trail?

content.lead: 一段穿越自然、教育与感官的旅程

content: Inca Braille Trail 位于美丽的印加圣谷(Cusco, Peru),是一项专为盲人和低视力人士及其家人、朋友和陪伴者开发的教育性感官体验。
我们的愿景是创造一个温馨的地方,让访客能够亲近自然、学习、探索并分享有意义的经历,并在赞助者和捐赠者的支持下免费开放。
这条步道旨在通过触觉、嗅觉、听觉和味觉唤醒感官。访客将发现植物的质感、香草与花朵的芬芳、自然的声音,以及自然世界带来的种种美妙体验。

boxes.title: 生命的循环 – 向 Pachamama 学习
content: 我们理念的核心,是对大地母亲 Pachamama 的敬意,以及对万物相互关联的理解。
通过我们的教育旅程“生命的循环”,访客将发现植物的需求与我们自身的需求是多么相似。
一粒小小的种子需要养分、水、温暖和照料才能生长,正如我们需要营养的食物、洁净的水、阳光和健康的环境才能茁壮成长。
植物从健康的土壤中汲取养分,从阳光中获取能量;而我们则依靠植物生产的食物获得自身的能量、成长和福祉。

content.lead: 健康的土壤滋养健康的植物,健康的植物滋养健康的人。

content: 动物在这一循环中同样不可或缺。从为花朵授粉的蜜蜂,到传播种子的鸟儿,再到提供天然肥料、让土壤更肥沃的农场动物,每一种生灵都在为自然的平衡贡献力量。
这些养分回归大地,帮助新的植物生长,完成了连接植物、动物与人的美丽循环。
在旅程中,访客将了解安第斯传统农耕和古代印加农耕,以及现代可持续农业。我们强调保存本土种子、堆肥、保护生物多样性,以及不依赖有害农药种植营养食物的重要性。
我们的目标是证明:爱护大地、生产健康食物可以是简单、可持续且人人可及的。

boxes.title: 人人相连的地方 – Ayni 的精神
content: Inca Braille Trail 的核心是古老的安第斯原则 Ayni,意为互惠——相信通过给予、接受和互相支持,我们能建立更坚强、更有同情心的社区。
我们的步道不只是一次教育体验。它是盲人和低视力人士及其家人、朋友和陪伴者相聚、分享经历、建立友谊、庆祝生活的地方。
我们也希望鼓励视力正常的访客更好地理解视障人士日常面对的挑战,培养更多的认识、同理心和尊重。
通过共同的经历,我们希望人们认识到:每个人都有宝贵的东西可以给予,我们都能从彼此身上学到东西。
正如我们滋养大地、大地滋养我们,通过善意、同情和互惠,我们彼此滋养。

content.lead: 这就是 Ayni 的精神,也是 Inca Braille Trail 的心。

boxes.title: 帮助建设步道
content:
WE NEED YOUR HELP!!!
Families are welcome!
Help bring the Inca Braille Trail to life
WHY ?
This Inca Braille Trail is the first of its kind with NFC/QR code technology to make education and sensory activities to the blind, general visually impaired and also to allow the general public with sight to enhance their other senses more intensely through sight deprivation.
Our hope is that once you experience this you will feel more compassion for those less fortunate and recognise your own sensitivity to your own inner magic.
Funds raised will go directly toward providing a free day at the Inca Braille Trail for people who are blind or have low vision, along with their families and carers. The day includes return transport from Cusco, lunch, and a gift to take home.
Often the careers and family are forgotten so lets celebrate this together by helping make this a fun and   ongoing event of a lifetime for all.

Help needed:
-Small stone paths
-Basic fencing
-Cooking
-Social Media
-General cleaning
-Raking
-planting aromatics

work.title: 看看志愿者的工作
work.lead: 我们正在努力修建步道。这里有几张我们工作的照片。
work.photo1: 三个人在土坡上砌石墙。一位花白胡子的人跪着，拿着卷尺。一位光头扛着一根长木头。另一位戴帽子的人俯身在石头上。身后是绿色集装箱和群山。
work.photo2: 同一面石墙。花白胡子的人拿着卷尺。戴帽子的人在砌石头。光头戴着红手套，拉着一把长柄工具。
work.photo3: 三个人在矮石墙边干活。花白胡子的人穿着印有橙色23的黑衬衫和高筒胶靴，对着镜头微笑。戴宽檐帽的人指向一侧。光头戴着红手套，俯身扶着一把耙子。身后是绿色集装箱、树木和群山。
work.photo4: 浅色墙的铁丝上挂着工具：一把小耕具、三把小铲、两把钳子和一把锯。一把叉立在土上，旁边是蓝色防水布和一个橙色袋子。
work.video: 同一项工作的动态画面：测量地面、砌石墙、搬运木材，身后是群山。

matias.name: Matias Lopez
matias.alt: Matias Lopez 蹲在一只正在金属碗里吃东西的美洲鸵旁边。他有黑发、胡须和眼镜，穿着深色衬衫，戴着工作手套。身后是蓝色篷布、一张桌子和树木。
matias.who: Matias Lopez 今年38岁，来自阿根廷。他来秘鲁是为了旅行，认识新的地方。
matias.work: 他是林业技术员，也是厨师，擅长面包。
matias.why: 他做志愿者，是因为这个项目很美好，也因为项目背后的用意。他觉得非常有意思。

patrick.name: Patrick De Vries
patrick.alt: Patrick De Vries 在石路上，挨着一只大白狗微笑。他是光头，穿着灰色衬衫，手里拿着写有自己名字的白色马克杯。背景是群山和树木。
patrick.who: Patrick De Vries 今年55岁，来自荷兰。他来秘鲁是为了探索这里的文化。

patrick.why: 帮助别人是他的天性。他喜欢参与一件新的、能让别人受益的事。

pamella.name: Pamella Garcia
pamella.alt: Pamella Garcia 在白色帆布帐篷的入口微笑。她留着深色短发，穿着印有彩色骷髅的黑衬衫，戴着项链。白帘和一根木梁框住她。
pamella.who: Pamella Garcia 今年31岁，来自巴西。她在秘鲁住了6年，因为这里让她觉得是自己的新家。

Age 46 French American horticulturist passionate about plants, nature and sustainable agriculture. He has extensive experience in plant cultivation, propagation and greenhouse management. Currently in Peru, he is exploring permaculture and tropical growing systems.
You will experience the duality of how correct care of seeds, plants and animal life deeply relates to ourselves.

educational.title: 教育步道 — {siteName}
educational.description: 一条讲述食物如何生长、变成堆肥回到泥土、再长成食物的步道。
educational.heroLine: 在这里，你顺着生命的循环学完整条路。
educational.heroAlt: 两只手在叶子之间托着绿色的小果子。一颗果子停在张开的手心里。
educational.lead:
Download the app: Then the experience begins.Two options:
1: Visually Impaired: Audio version
2: SIghted: QR/NFC scan at stations..

All Junction points have Braille information cards.
1. Visually Impaired: Audio version
You will have a trained volunteer who will accompany you if you do not have a sighted guide. The guided audio will take you on a journey through 20 stations of information. There will be 4 rest points along the way. At each rest point you will have to answer 5 questions before moving to the next.A hand rail will help guide you along the path. A ball at the end of each hand rail will signify a change of hand rail from right to left or left to right. White cane detectable stone edges shall guide your direction on the path.A bell at the end of each rail will signify an easy to find seating area to answer your Q&A.
educational.p1:
Ecology:
Working together...Important fun Facts on route

Culture and History: Identifying cultural and historical foods and practices from Inca to us.
Seed preparation: cultivation, storage and why we must protect them for future generations.
Soil: Soil preparation, Composting, Microbes and care
Insects: Pollination, Beneficial species and natural pest management.
Animal Input: Sources from other beneficial animals
Plant Care: Plant relationships, Identifying disease and management
Replanting:  Cycles of harvesting, helping the ecosystems, environmental help
Harvesting: When and how
Global Impact: Looking at new and old data to prepare for changes
Water Management: Water testing, Identifying problems, New solutions, Cleaning and maintenance, Preserve and protect.
Replanting: Cycles of harvesting, environmental help
Animal Care: Understanding how animals play a big role in supporting the cycle of life, from plowing the fields to animal waste. Learning to listen and sense their behaviors.
(expand)
Community: Working with others, relationships, Supporting and  sharing.
educational.p3: 健康的泥土长出健康的植物。健康的植物养活健康的人。教育步道把这个想法讲成一条可以走的路。

sensory.title: 感官步道 — {siteName}
sensory.description: 一条靠触摸、气味、声音和脚下土地行走的路，为视障人士和同行的人而设。
sensory.heroLine: On this path you learn to identify and use the plants. All downloaded as you go to use in the future.
sensory.heroAlt: 一位留着胡子的人侧身靠近绿色的植物。画面上方只露出眼镜的下沿。
sensory.lead:
Download the app: Then the experience begins.Feel or see the Braille Map layout from beginning to end
Two options:
1: Visually Impaired: Audio version
2: SIghted: QR/NFC scan at stations..
All Junction points have Braille information cards.
Visually Impaired: Audio version

On this sensory path you will experience the many wonders and aromas the Apus (Mountain Spirits) and Pachamama (Mother Earth) nourish us with. There will also be QR/NFC markers provided with detailed information about individual plants, traditional, medicinal, culinary and personal care uses and how to prepare them.All this information you will be able to take away with you so you can refer to it at any time.
The main reason is that I personally have visited many information trails and wasn't able to retain the information or i wrote things down and  lost the information over time, but now you can refer to it when ever needed.
Enjoy :)
sensory.p1: 在感官步道上，人们被邀请慢慢走，用身体遇见这个地方。绳制扶手领着路。石头、木头、叶子和花都可以触摸。香草和湿土带来气味。水、鸟和风带来声音。
sensory.p2: 脚下从石头变成泥土，每一步都告诉你身在何处。这条路上没有一件事依靠视力。

sponsors.title: 赞助 — {siteName}
sponsors.description: 品牌或机构可以与这个项目同行。征得同意后，标志会出现在页面底部。
sponsors.heroLine: 请参与这个美好的项目，送出你的支持。
sponsors.heroAlt: 绿色的凤眼莲果实和圆叶一起浮在褐色的水面上。
sponsors.lead: 如果你有一个品牌，并愿意与这条步道同行，请写信给我们。
sponsors.p1: 合作伙伴可以用合适的方式出力：为道路提供材料，付出劳动，分享想法，或赞助这个项目。
sponsors.p2: 如果你有品牌或机构，并想成为这条路上的伙伴，请写信给我们，我们会回复。
sponsors.p3: 征得同意后，你的标志会出现在页面底部，和其他合作伙伴放在一起。

app.title: Inka Braille Trail App — {siteName}
app.description: Inka Braille Trail App 引导盲人和低视力访客走完游览，并讲述每一站的故事。
app.lead: 这个应用把这条步道开放给盲人和低视力的人。
app.p1: 它引导访客走完游览。在每一站讲述那个地方的故事，让人可以边听边走。
app.p2: 看不见，也能走到这条路上。每一站都有声音，站点的故事就是路标。
app.p3: 应用的图片会放在下面的空位里。
